scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!ua.includes('pnpm')){console.error('This repo uses pnpm. Please run: pnpm install'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @soma/soma run typecheck && pnpm --filter @soma/tapia run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @soma/soma run lint && pnpm --filter @soma/tapia run lint
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @soma/soma run format && pnpm --filter @soma/tapia run format
